_comment: **Deep water is deliberately NOT on this tag.** Vanilla's tag names `minecraft:water` directly, and it is
what lets vanilla's bubble column occupy a block: any ordinary water block over magma or soul sand raises
one, and it climbs through everything on this tag -- so with deep water on it, a column raised anywhere
below climbed straight through the abyss and turned it ordinary (Jonah, walked 2026-09-14).
Our own column, `DeepBubbleColumnBlock`, admits deep water itself, so a whirlpool still rises in the
abyss; only vanilla's is kept out. The file stays, empty, so the reasoning does.
